source: Agilysys OnDemand, princeton.buy-ondemand.com, the Late Meal concept read by hand in a browser while open. The site is behind DataDome and publishes no nutrition.
note: The items are the Late Meal concept 10110 menu (display profile 4912), confirmed open on Mon 2026-11-02 at ASAP pickup: 11 'Late Meal Combos' ($11.50 each, meal swipe only, each with a fountain soda) and a 'Daily Special' with fries. Every combo is listed by its entree name. The fountain soda is not counted (log a drink on its own). The grill's Side Salad is not on Late Meal and was dropped. French Fries stays as the side, not as an item Late Meal sells alone. Daily specials carry 'days'; only Monday's Trenton Burger had an item to read. Tue Grilled Reuben, Wed Southwest Burger, Thu Rodeo Burger and Fri Hot Honey Chicken Tenders are listed with no item yet, TO BE ADDED when read on their day. Every number is an ESTIMATE built from components; see each item's basis. Component values: kcal/protein g/carbs g/fat g.
